title: P0 Entity, IP assignment and trademark
body:
founder: incorporate; assign/license core from author to the entity in writing (QNFO-ULA v2.1 prohibits commercial use without a separate grant); USPTO knockout search for Ultrastable. Closing probe: signed assignment on file; entity name set in LICENSE.

size: M

title: P1 Short default policy pack
body:
Extract a short default policy (agreement every agent lane reads) from QNFO's CLAUDE.md/doctrine; QNFO keeps owner directives as an overlay.

size: M

title: P2 Core tables in their own database
body:
Move core tables (agent_issues, issue_triage, work_claims, metric_registry, trust_ledger, decision_log, failure_modes, ...) out of qnfo-audit into a product database.

size: L

title: P3 Tenant settings from configuration
body:
Account, repository, hosts, model ladder, owner contact come from configuration, not constants.

size: L

title: P4 Second installation outside qnfo-workers
body:
Prove the core runs on a repository that is not qnfo-workers (design partner or internal).

size: L

title: Pilot sign-up flow
body:
Replace the mailto link with a form storing requests (D1) plus a confirmation; tap-based, no free text beyond email.

size: M

title: Recruit 3 design partners
body:
Outreach list, pilot terms, success metric (agent-opened PRs merged, probe reverts, scored predictions). Measure: signed pilots.

size: M

title: Outside audit of prediction match rate
body:
73% self-scored match; get an external audit or benchmark.

size: M

title: Investor materials
body:
Pitch deck, one-page market read, financial model, demo script from ultrastable.io/proof.

size: M

title: Claims feed on its own host
body:
Serve platform claims from a product-side endpoint (current feed links the public QNFO repo).

size: S

title: Private source of truth
body:
Move site code, docs and tests into the private repo; CI deploys to Cloudflare; remove reliance on the deployed worker as the only copy.

size: S

title: Analytics and measurement
body:
Visits to /proof from outside, pilot emails, claims passing; weekly digest.

size: S
